\caption[The overall comparison]{The overall comparison of the twelve entries.  For each view (primary view: late era, horizons 1--15; secondary view: early era, horizons 1--15; both eras pooled: both eras, horizons 1--15; sensitivity view: late era, horizons 16--25; recent origins: 2005--2015, horizons 1--15) and composite (full output: each sex's level, the gap, the age-specific sex differences, the age pattern and the uncertainty; $e_0$ only: the level, the gap and the uncertainty), the share (\%) of 20{,}000 draws of family weights (Dirichlet(1,\dots,1)), each with a bootstrap of population families, in which the entry ranks first, and its mean rank.  In the sensitivity view (16--25 years), bayesLife's male and average $e_0$ drift away beyond 15 years: its gap model, fitted to the data up to the origin, widens the gap between the sexes without bound.  Bold, underlined, italic: the best, second and third value in each column of each view, the best being the largest share and the smallest mean rank.}\label{tab:ev_overall}\\
